failure_modes.name: Query_Form_Mismatch
failure_modes.evidence: Query for hop 2: 'Is "Twelfth Night" by William Shakespeare also known by the alternative title "What You Will"?' - This is a natural-language yes/no question rather than a well-formed entity-based query.

failure_modes.name: Query_Stagnation
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 2 retrieves documents including 'Twelfth Night | Twelfth Night, or What You Will is a comedy by William Shakespeare' and 'Malvolio | Malvolio is the steward of Olivia's household in William Shakespeare's comedy "Twelfth Night, or What You Will"'. Hop 3 query 'Twelfth Night, What You Will, She's the Man Shakespeare' retrieves nearly identical documents: same 'Twelfth Night' article, same 'Malvolio' article, same film adaptations. The queries fail to advance despite hop 2 already containing sufficient evidence.

failure_modes.name: Solver_Irrelevant_Passage_Overprocessing
failure_modes.evidence: After hop 1, the solver extensively analyzes irrelevant passages such as 'I Know What You Did Last Summer', 'Do You Know What It Means to Miss New Orleans?', 'About What You Know', and 'You Know What to Do (Carly Simon song)' - none of which relate to Shakespeare or the claim being verified.
